# Bows (skill)

Description: Determines, damage, ,, stamina, cost and, draw time, with Bows (skill).

# Introduction

Bows (skill) is a skill related to Bows weapon class.

## Effects

Higher skill level in bows reduces the stamina cost to attack down to -33%, increases damage and knockback up to +141% and reduces draw time up to -80%.
For the details of damage scaling, see Damage mechanics#Skill factor.

## Leveling up

The player gains 1.5xp per arrow when hitting a creature.
